name: dogfood-form-ct
description: Dogfood app (v1.16-3) — 5 form Playwright Component Testing patterns (login / signup / checkout / profile / search) driven through a mock adapter (@kiwa/component createPlaywrightCTMock + mount + interact) and a real adapter (@playwright/experimental-ct-react, env-skip when PW_CT_ENDPOINT is unset). Each form is asserted on 4 axes — mount + validation error + submit success + a11y violation count = 0. Fidelity feeds @kiwa/quality-metrics 7-axis release gate + 4 latency samples from perf-harness for the 3-layer perf report.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa/component -F @kiwa/core -F @kiwa/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
